year.description: Four-digit observation year; use /years or scoped /availability first. Not a release/vintage date. Explicit unavailable years are never replaced.

indicator.description: Registered metric key or exact World Bank indicator code; read its units and supported methods.

country.description: Eligible economy ISO3. Official aggregates belong in entity specs.

subject.description: Registered subject key. Metrics retain independent units and denominators.

series.description: Comma-separated registered metric keys, optionally real_gdp_growth; at most eight, and a history window of at most 100 annual years.

entityA.description: country:ISO3, aggregate:CODE, or group:ISO3,ISO3. Group members are eligible countries only, maximum 50; percent-encode query values with URLSearchParams.

entityB.description: Same entity encoding as entityA; official aggregate values are read as published.

basis.description: Registered basis for the selected metric. Omit for the default raw basis; never infer a basis from another indicator.

operation.description: Supported analysis for this metric/entity/basis. Compare uses level, absolute_change, percent_change, pp_change, index_point_change, cagr, cross_rate, period_total, period_average, movement_period_total, movement_period_average, movement_inflation_cumulative, period_total_growth or segmented_growth as permitted. Periods/summary uses SUM or AVG.

groupMode.description: Compare population policy; like_for_like requires a custom group. Complete/common universes are returned by the calculation.

members.description: Comma-separated eligible ISO3 codes, at least one, at most 50; an aggregate cannot be a member.

search.description: Country name or ISO3 search; rank positions retain the full population.

includeAggregates.description: Country registry aggregate inclusion; false for focus/group membership.

mode.description: comparison/level value or approved YoY-growth comparison.

detail.description: Comparison detail projection; evidence remains available through the full response.

groupType.description: Supported World Bank country classification key.

group.description: A returned classification value, not a custom entity spec.

availabilityDiscovery.instruction: Discover committed indicator/economy years and valid adjacent YoY pairs, then send explicit numeric years. The public API does not accept year=latest. Historical examples intentionally keep their dates.

encoding: Encode query values with URLSearchParams or equivalent UTF-8 percent encoding; entity colons and group/series commas are query values, not path separators.

errors.400: Invalid request or unsupported operation; inspect code and message.
errors.404: Optional publication disabled or unknown resource.
errors.503: Temporary service or publication authority failure; retry later, never assume authorization.
